cohort: 251 adult patients with acute respiratory failure (ARF) associated with COVID-19 pneumonia, including 17 pregnant patients
finding: Viral load was substantially higher in pregnant ICU patients with COVID-19 and ARF compared with non-pregnant ICU patients with COVID-19 and ARF.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean delivery was independently associated with a modest but significant improvement in arterial oxygenation.
gest_age: Median gestational age at ICU admission was 28 + 3/7 weeks
